name: Raymond Page
title: Engineering Leader | Developer Experience | AI Enablement | Platform Strategy
summary: Engineering leader with 12 years of enterprise software engineering, cloud platform, and developer enablement experience at Mutual of Omaha, preceded by a 26-year U.S. Air Force career progressing from enlisted airman to field grade officer. Proven track record leading cross-functional teams, building shared platform capabilities, driving adoption of engineering standards, and fostering technology communities that improve organizational effectiveness. Recognized within Mutual of Omaha as a technology leader in API-led architecture, MuleSoft, cloud integration, and AI-assisted engineering practices. Focused on helping engineers deliver business outcomes through shared platforms, common patterns, and accessible organizational knowledge.

highlights.title: Strategic Enterprise Initiative Leadership
highlights.description: Consistently selected by leadership to drive strategic enterprise initiatives — including MuleSoft Adoption, the Process API Initiative, and Service AI Enablement — leveraging expertise in API-led architecture, cloud integration, and emerging AI capabilities.

highlights.title: AI-Enabled Customer Service Delivery
highlights.description: Drove development and productionization of AI-enabled customer service capabilities for the Service AI Enablement initiative, accelerating delivery across customer, policy, billing, claims, and beneficiary functions.

highlights.title: Engineering Enablement Programs
highlights.description: Created and launched a self-service, video-based training curriculum (MuleSoft Days) that strengthened engineering skill development and reinforced golden-path adoption — 53+ documented participants, with continued organic use enterprise-wide.

highlights.title: Communities of Practice
highlights.description: Founder and facilitator of enterprise Communities of Practice spanning AI, AR/VR, and cloud engineering — driving knowledge sharing and accelerating organizational adoption of new capabilities.

highlights.title: Engineering Leadership at Scale
highlights.description: Led engineering teams ranging from 5–14 members across four initiatives over the past decade, including 12 direct reports as Information Services Manager.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented enterprise API and integration solutions using MuleSoft, AWS, and Spring Boot supporting customer, policy, billing, and claims capabilities.
Selected to participate in enterprise evaluation and user acceptance testing of GitHub Enterprise against GitLab, informing the organization's DevOps toolchain strategy.
Engineering lead for the Process API Initiative, directing a team of 5 developers on API-led modernization efforts.
Co-lead for Service AI Enablement, jointly leading a team of 7 developers building AI-enabled customer service capabilities.
Serve as subject matter expert and leading advocate for API-led architecture and MuleSoft adoption across the enterprise engineering organization.
Defined MuleSoft developer skill and competency requirements, establishing a framework used for hiring, onboarding, and skills development enterprise-wide.

Created and launched the MuleSoft Days training program, designing a self-service, video-based curriculum optimized to strengthen engineering intelligence while reinforcing reuse and pipeline capability adoption; 53+ documented participants, with continued organic use enterprise-wide.

Authored one of the first MuleSoft API templates onboarded to the enterprise's Common Technology Platform Service Portal (CTPSP), a golden-path starting point still heavily used today that significantly reduces developer time to baseline new MuleSoft APIs.

Developed additional engineering templates and reference implementations, and partnered with architecture, product, and business stakeholders to expand shared enterprise services and improve discoverability of system capabilities.
Founded and facilitate Communities of Practice across AI, AR/VR, and cloud engineering, driving knowledge sharing and accelerating organizational adoption of new capabilities.
Champion AI-assisted and agentic development approaches to improve team productivity and engineering effectiveness.

roles.title: Information Services Manager
bullets: Directly managed a team of 12 engineers and analysts, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development while leading Agile software delivery for Senior Health/Medicare marketplace initiatives.
Built team strength grids and skill matrixes to guide workforce planning, individual development plans, and succession readiness across the team.
Applied servant leadership principles to strengthen team performance and support delivery of customer-facing capabilities.
Aligned team execution to Agile Release Train objectives and enterprise priorities in partnership with business sponsors.

roles.title: Enterprise Salesforce Scrum Master / Project Manager
bullets: Led a cross-functional Salesforce development team of 14 engineers across multiple enterprise implementation initiatives, directing sprint execution, technical delivery, and stakeholder alignment.
Helped establish Mutual of Omaha's early adoption of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), codifying delivery patterns later scaled enterprise-wide.
Coordinated delivery across product owners and technical leadership while supporting organizational change initiatives.

roles.title: IS Portfolio Manager
bullets: Managed and coordinated a $100M enterprise technology portfolio spanning multiple business and engineering organizations.
Led adoption of enterprise Agile planning and portfolio management tooling across multiple portfolios.
Drove cross-organizational alignment among executive sponsors and technology leadership to improve planning transparency and execution.
Supported enterprise culture transformation initiatives in partnership with Senn Delaney.

roles.title: Scrum Master
bullets: Coached teams through early adoption of Agile practices, improving engagement, transparency, and delivery predictability.
Managed enterprise strategy and portfolio backlogs, aligning technology execution with business priorities.
Reduced governance friction while maintaining visibility and accountability across program stakeholders.

roles.title: Officer & Technology Leader
bullets: Officer and technology leader with 26 years of progressive leadership experience spanning communications, information technology, systems development, operations, and organizational management.
Advanced from enlisted member to field grade officer through demonstrated leadership and technical excellence.
Led geographically dispersed teams in high-reliability operational environments.
Managed large-scale technology initiatives, vendor relationships, and mission-critical systems.
Directed development efforts supporting next-generation geospatial weather systems.
Managed contractor and vendor engagements supporting operations at Kennedy Space Center.
